entities.title: Repository tooling
entities.summary: Two Python scripts: the structural checks of the specification material, and the generator of the side-by-side page.
entities.purpose: Keeps the language-neutral material consistent and the generated documentation current. validate.py checks the schema, the conformance examples and fixtures, the JSON examples embedded in spec/*.md, and that the falsehoods matrix and its scenarios agree. side_by_side.py builds docs/side-by-side.md from the five libraries' UTV-first example tests.
boundaries: Structure only: validate.py performs no semantic validation, resolution or any other part of a UTV engine.
It runs none of the language libraries' tests; each library runs its own (AGENTS.md section 3).
requirements.txt names the one dependency, jsonschema; side_by_side.py needs only the standard library.
